property_summary: A non-owner can change `difficulty` via `AdjustDifficulty` in the buggy version, while only the owner can do so in the reference; the bug breaks the rule that `currentDifficulty()` remains unchanged when a non-owner calls `AdjustDifficulty`.
change_summary: Delete the `require(msg.sender == owner);` statement from the `onlyOwner` modifier, allowing anyone to call `AdjustDifficulty`.
